annotation.title_clean: From Agriculture 4.0 to Human-Centered Agriculture 5.0: Integrating AI, IoT, Robotics, Digital Twins, and Responsible Governance for Sustainable Farming
annotation.title_en: From Agriculture 4.0 to Human-Centered Agriculture 5.0: Integrating AI, IoT, Robotics, Digital Twins, and Responsible Governance for Sustainable Farming
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Pakaya, R.; Wijayanti, D.; Segar, S.
annotation.venue: International Journal of Research and Review
annotation.summary_en: Review of 55 Scopus-indexed studies (2019–2025) on AI, IoT, robotics and digital twins in agriculture. It argues for a shift to human-centered Agriculture 5.0 and proposes a sense–interpret–decide–act–learn–govern framework, stressing explainability, data rights, cybersecurity, accountability and inclusive adoption.
key_provisions_or_claims: High model accuracy does not guarantee reliable farm decisions; data sparsity and distribution shift persist.
Proposes a sense–interpret–decide–act–learn–govern framework with accountable oversight.
AI should augment rather than displace farmers, preserving agency and data rights.
Governance responses: open standards, cybersecurity baselines, traceable decisions, risk-based regulation.
Six research priorities including explainable robust AI, edge intelligence and inclusive adoption.
